answer: In PoA, reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life: each service interaction decays predictably, so an identity must sustain honest, reciprocated behavior to retain weight. EigenTrust matrix factorization propagates credibility through reciprocity-weighted transitivity, while freshly spawned sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted paths. Names such as nebula, pigment, or dune add no influence until independently verified service accumulates, so they cannot pass consensus.
